issue.title: Could not initialize class org.mockito.internal.util.MockUtil" - Maven , Mockito > 2.0.111-beta
issue.body:
I get a "java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: **Could not initialize class org.mockito.internal.util.MockUtil"** when running junit tests in maven (fine in Eclipse) and using a mockito version > 2.0.111-beta.

**Environment**
- Mockito - 2.1.0-RC.1 (issue started after 2.0.111-beta)
- Maven - 3.3.9 (tests work in eclipse)
- JUnit - 4.12 + MockitoJUnitRunner
- JDK - 1.8.0_60-b27 

Happy to help triage but don't know what more to share at the moment.
